post.originalText:
One prompt. 12 minutes. One weasel with absolutely zero chill. 🦦🍦

Gemini 4 Argon built this 3D village chase—with chiptunes, turbo boosts, and weasel tornadoes.
Play it, then compare 23 AI takes on the exact same prompt:

https://t.co/57nkW23o7v https://t.co/atRwlFWsVJ
